verdict.rationale: Bugbot automatically reviews every PR and PR update in the background, covering bugs, security and code quality, and is offered across all repos and all PRs. The docs pair it directly with Cloud Agents, which open PRs that Bugbot then reviews, and configurable high effort reportedly finds 35% more bugs at an 80% resolution rate. Community users report it catches genuine bugs most reviewers miss, though one notes it flip-flopped on its own suggested fix. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of handling tuned to agent-authored PRs, throughput/volume data, and independent corroboration of review quality on AI-generated code at scale.
